title: keyval.dev.error/v1
description: The envelope any ./dev command prints on stdout in --json mode when it cannot produce its normal report (xtask/src/output.rs). Exit status 2 for `usage`, 1 for the other kinds.

kind.description: usage: invalid arguments, nothing ran; internal: could not complete; refused: preconditions not met; not_implemented: planned surface that does not exist yet (never a pass, P10).
